## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (`npm test`), or not needed for this change
- [ ] End-to-end tests updated (`npm run test:e2e`), if UI or blocker behavior changed
- [ ] Lint passes (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Typecheck passes (`npm run typecheck`)
- [ ] Documentation updated (README, PRIVACY.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, or CHANGELOG.md), if needed
- [ ] Logic in `src/core` stays pure (no browser APIs, DOM, or Preact imports)
- [ ] No new permissions were added to the manifest. If they were, the justification is below.
- [ ] No network requests, analytics, or remote code were added
